title: AI models – level 2
paragraphs: AI influencers like Aitana, with her pink hair, are becoming popular on social media and are making money by promoting products.

Aitana, who doesn’t exist in real life, is an AI model created by a Barcelona-based company. They make her look very real, which attracts thousands of followers. Many people are worried about the effects of AI influencers on young people because they could create unrealistic body images, and it may make followers feel insecure. Some people ask if it is good to promote a perfect body image. Although her agency tried to create different models, the clients preferred standard ones. Recently, Aitana even signed a deal with a car company to be the face of an in-car assistant. This shows how popular AI influencers are becoming.

words.d: to support something or help it become successful
not showing things as they are
